title: Screenshots
intro: Pieces of the screen taken with Ctrl+Alt+S in the desktop app, with what you drew on them. They are kept in a folder of every computer and here, the same everywhere: delete one anywhere, and it goes everywhere.
desktopOnly: Screenshots are taken in the desktop app (Ctrl+Alt+S); its folder syncs with this list.
confirmDelete: Delete the screenshot here and from the folders of every computer?
